I went to Brain & Co in May 2024 for a persistent balance issue that started in Dec 2022. Having tried all that I could, including conventional Allopathy, Homeopathy,
Acupuncture & Ayurveda without much success, I was always researching on what was the one thing could help me.

I came across Neurofeedback/Biofeedback as a treatment option for dizziness/imbalance on the Internet and looked up the clinics offering it in Mumbai. Luckily, I zeroed down on Brain&Co and visited their Parel clinic for the first consultation. That first visit gave me some confidence though I remained skeptical, as I thought how could brain training help if the dizziness had a physical component to it. This has been possible only because of Rohit and his constant encouragement. The staff (Nikita & Deepak) are courteous and polite and seem to know each patient's movie preference which feels like personalized attention :)

Again I am extremely happy that I came to know about Brain & Co's existence and would sincerely recommend everyone suffering from chronic health conditions to give it a try. Each Saturday I am happy to go there as I get to watch a good movie with full concentration and without any worries or cares floating into my mind. I would not mind going there for the rest of my life :) it is that enjoyable.

Wishing Rohit, his team & staff many more glorious years of helping others. Sometimes charity is done as a business & at other times business is done as a charity - Brain&Co is the latter !
